ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Msiexec Quiet Install From Remote Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of Msiexec.exe to install packages hosted remotely quietly

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "msiexec\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/i.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-package.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/package.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-a.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/a.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-j.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/j.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-q.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/q.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\.*")))
